knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

```{r}
names(listings)
```
```{r}

```


##Task 1
```{r}
 listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id) |>
  dplyr::filter(n >= 10) |>
  dplyr::count()

#Part 2

listings |>
  dplyr::add_count(host_id, name = "host_n") |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::summarise(pct = round(100 * mean(host_n >= 10), 1))
```

##Task 2
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_listings = dplyr::n(),
    median_ppp = median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(n_listings >= 20) |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::slice_min(median_ppp, n = 1)
```

##Task 3
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
listings|>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities", room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  dplyr::pull(estimated_revenue_l365d)
```

##Task 4
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(top10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    top10_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top10], na.rm = TRUE),
    total_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_top10 = round(100 * top10_revenue / total_revenue, 1)
  )|>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::pull(pct_top10)
```

```{r}
names(availability)
```


##Task 5
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    availability |> dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10"),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    n_homes = dplyr::n(),
    share_mostly_taken = mean(mostly_taken, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::slice_min(share_mostly_taken)
```


```{r}
names(reviews)
```


##Task 6
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::inner_join(reviews, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::filter(month >= "2025-07", month <= "2026-06") |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))
```

##Task 8
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::count()
```

##Task 7
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt", !is.na(host_is_superhost)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    superhost_median = median(price[host_is_superhost == "t"], na.rm = TRUE),
    other_median     = median(price[host_is_superhost == "f"], na.rm = TRUE),
    premium          = superhost_median - other_median,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(premium))
```

```{r}
host_share <- listings |>
  dplyr::add_count(host_id, name = "host_n") |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(a2_pct = round(100 * mean(host_n >= 10), 1))

top10_share <- listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(top10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    a5_pct = round(100 * sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top10], na.rm = TRUE) /
                     sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  )

dplyr::left_join(host_share, top10_share, by = "city")
```
